newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile condemns guerrilla attack in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Chile condemns guerrilla attack in Peru.

text.p: Chile condemned on Wednesday the attack by armed leftist guerrillas on the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima, but said no Chilean diplomats were among about 200 hostages being held in the building.
"Chile's Foreign Ministry expresses its most energetic repudiation and condemnation of this act which violates all the principles of international law," said the statement.
"The government makes a fervent call for all the hostages ... to be freed safely and unharmed immediately."
Rebels of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement stormed the ambassador's house on Tuesday night during a reception, attended by numerous top officials, for the Emperor's birthday.
Chile will be reinforcing security measures at its northern border with Peru to make sure no guerrillas escape across the frontier, said Foreign Minister Jose Miguel Insulza.
